assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.placeholder: Type a question or “/” for commands…
assistant.introMessage:
Hi! I'm your AI schedule assistant 👋

- Ask about your schedule (e.g. "what do I have tomorrow?")
- Type **/analyze** to find problems in the schedule
- Create and edit events with the **/magic** command (e.g. "/magic create a Lecture on Monday at 10:00")

Start typing "/" to see the commands.

about.p1: is not just a platform for organizing schedules and communication — it's a whole ecosystem of opportunities that gives users limitless possibilities for working together.
about.p2: Each user can customize their personal space using a range of functional tools that make organizing events and collaboration easier. With intuitive tools, users can post announcements, create tasks, share news, and much more.
about.p3: GroupTime offers a wide range of teamwork capabilities, letting you interact with your colleagues or friends in the most efficient way. All of this is aimed at creating a comfortable and productive environment to achieve your goals and plans.
about.p4: With GroupTime, every day can be filled with new opportunities where you can join exciting projects and events. Join us and let's build an inspiring and growing community together!
